vo.en: Your arm is about to float.

visual.description: A close up of a hand slowly rising against a dark, moody background with particles.

vo.en: Find a wall. Stand sideways and press the back of your hand against it.

visual.description: A man in profile standing next to a concrete wall prepared to push.

vo.en: Push as hard as you can. Seriously, use all your strength for thirty seconds.

visual.description: A close up of a tensed arm muscle and a fist pressing against a hard surface.

vo.en: But here is the creepy part. Your brain is about to lose control of your body.

visual.description: Abstract digital glitch overlay over a stylized 3D model of a human brain.

vo.en: Keep pushing. Ten more seconds. Five, four, three, two, one. Step away and relax.

visual.description: A mechanical stopwatch ticking down rapidly followed by a man stepping back from a wall.

vo.en: Your arm is rising on its own. This is the Kohnstamm phenomenon, a literal glitch in your motor system.

visual.description: An arm rising slowly and involuntarily as if pulled by an invisible string.

vo.en: Your neurons are still firing even though you stopped. Subscribe for more brain tests and comment if it worked, which is exactly why

visual.description: A close up of a man's thumb tapping the subscribe button on a smartphone screen.
